Ramona.name: Joyce Boysel (Joyful#1)
Ramona.text: Very timely and diagnosed and fixed the problem right away!

Ramona.name: Dennis Albert
Ramona.text:
I’m an early riser, and one recent morning at 5 a.m., I discovered that my well water had stopped working. The local company I’d used in the past was no longer in business. After searching online for a new service, I found Southern California Well Service—which, as it turns out, had actually acquired the old company.
I noted their phone number and email address, and since it was too early to call, I sent an email, planning to follow up after 8 a.m. To my surprise, I received a call from Southern California Well Service at 5:30 a.m.! We quickly scheduled an appointment.
Brian, the technician, kept me updated on his arrival time as he was delayed by issues at a prior job. Once he arrived, he quickly diagnosed the problem: a faulty capacitor. He had the replacement part on his truck, and within 20 minutes, the repair was complete. Power was restored, the pump was running properly, and water pressure returned to normal.
Southern California Well Service—and Brian in particular—exceeded my expectations. They were prompt, professional, and efficient. I highly recommend them!

Ramona.name: Jerry Sanders
Ramona.text:

That part was received and installed the same week.
GREAT SERVICE
